adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first`. If the id is unknown, `host` will be `nil`. Both paths then dereference it (`save_host(host)` calls `host.host = ...` and `destroy` calls `host.destroy`), which will raise `NoMethodError` and produce a 500 instead of a controlled 404/not-found response. This is a real correctness issue introduced by the shown code; the duplication note is also accurate but secondary.
